title: Judges set to decide fate of police chief constable guilty of contempt of court
summary: Exclusive: Ivan Balhatchet, Northamptonshire’s chief constable, could face up to two years in jail or a fine for repeated failure to obey rulings A police chief constable has been found guilty of contempt of court with judges set to consider whether he should be punished by imprisonment or a fine. The court of appeal ruled on Tuesday that Northamptonshire police were in contempt and had been “willfully disobedient” for repeatedly failing to obey rulings to hand over video to a woman who complained she had been wrongly arrested by three officers.
